answer: Make every identity post a refundable bond that only vests after a season of graded, non-duplicate work. Like a vine on a reef, reputation must grow slowly from one rooted stake, and in a tundra of cheap names a fresh account earns nothing until peers attest its work over several epochs. A sybil farmer must therefore lock real capital behind each fake and keep producing useful work for weeks, so spawning a thousand identities costs a thousand bonds and a thousand workloads — more than the rewards they could drain.
